name: Jeremiah
overview: Jeremiah was a male prophet uniquely identified as the son of Habazziniah, the Rechabite, as noted in Jeremiah 35:3. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his lineage connects him to a faithful family known for obedience to God's commands. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him beyond this distinctive heritage.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremiah means 'y-h-v-h loosens [the womb]; y-h-v-h lifts up; [poss.] y-h-v-h shoots, establishes,' reflecting God's active involvement in his life and mission. This proper name, recorded in Jeremiah 35:3, reveals a divine association but was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Jeremiah as the son of Habazziniah, with Jaazaniah inferred as his father. Beyond these connections, no further family relationships are documented, limiting our understanding of his familial background to these references in Jeremiah 35:3.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremiah stands as a faithful prophet called by God in his youth to warn Judah of impending judgment, enduring opposition and suffering throughout his ministry. His prophetic messages include the promise of a New Covenant, pointing forward to Christ and the gospel's fulfillment. His life exemplifies steadfast obedience amid rejection, and his lamentations reveal deep sorrow over the consequences of sin, underscoring his vital role in God's redemptive plan.

keyEvents.event: Called by God as a youth
